Name: Zebrus Core
Author: Zebruu

If you don't like that, you're [/size][/color][color=#ff0000][size=3]free [/size][/color][color=#ff7700][size=3]to choose [/size][/color][color=#ff0000][size=3]not [/size][/color][color=#ff7700][size=3]to use this mod![/size][/color] [/b]

[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Zebrus Core adds a shared, in-game search menu that other Zebrus mods can plug into. It handles the text search box, a dynamic filter row, the results list, the detail view, keyboard/mouse/controller/mobile input, and a "My Location" button that jumps the location filter to wherever you're currently standing.

Filters shown in the menu adapt automatically to whatever mod is being searched. For example, Zebrus Where is my Fish shows season, weather, catch category and catch status filters, while Zebrus Where is my NPC shows gender and marriageable filters instead. Filters with no relevant data for the current search are hidden automatically rather than shown empty.

Zebrus Core also exposes a small mod-to-mod API so other mods (including ones I haven't built yet) can register their own searchable data without needing to reimplement the menu, filtering, or input handling from scratch.[/color]

[size=4][b]Language[/b][/size]
[size=3]English and German[/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]- SMAPI 4.0.0 or later
- Stardew Valley 1.6 or later[/color]

[size=4][b]Optional[/b][/size]
- Generic Mod Config Menu (for the in-game settings menu)

[b][size=4]Compatibility[/size][/b]
- Multiplayer/split-screen safe. Should work alongside virtually any other mod, since it doesn't change any vanilla game data or behavior by itself.
